knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Immediate danger means the emergency service is called first.
The tutor does not promise secrecy and must get help for the learner.
The concern is escalated to the nominated person the same day.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives a scenario and checks that the candidate names the first action, the record and the escalation
Assessor reviews a concern record for facts, words used, date and time, with no added opinion
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. A reviewer must confirm the jurisdiction duty before approval.
evidenceRequired: Jurisdiction reporting duty note, with source
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate promises a learner that a concern will be kept secret
The candidate investigates a concern with leading questions
The candidate tells the named adult before the nominated person has advised
